build_flags.detail: 242 of 242 translation units do NOT carry -ffp-contract=off (first: ../../src/Core/AI.m). Without it clang may fuse a*b+c into a single FMA, which rounds once instead of twice and changes the low bits of every float in the dump - exactly the cross-platform variation the golden policy exists to remove.

note: Scenario 012 RetroMissions test-OXP (bead oo-3ya): the in-tree fixture upstream/oolite-tests/test-oxps/RetroMissions/RetroMissions.oxp is staged into a private OO_ADDITIONALADDONSDIRS root, the game runs 24 ticks of game time in Lave, and the dump carries an evidence block proving the expansion's content went LIVE: 6 world-script names a stock game lacks, of which ahruman-reaper resolves to a live JS object with version '1', the other 5 being legacy plist keys. RetroMissions ships NO manifest.plist (bead oo-kcrw's NOMANIF class - a property of these legacy fixtures) and the run tolerates EXACTLY 2 '[oxp-standards.error]: OXP RetroMissions.oxp has no manifest.plist' lines and no other oxp-standards error; a third or different line fails the run. No manifest is staged. See tests/golden/pending/012-retro-missions/README.md. provenance.scenario_knobs records the determinism knobs this golden was BLESSED with; the acceptance gate asserts spec.json still agrees with them, so re-blessing with a new seed stays legal while silent drift between spec and golden is fatal.
